full_judgment: 5. The positive case of defendants 10-14 in short is that the suit land originally belonged to Dwarika Nath Bjswas and his brother, that Owarika Nath died leaving two sons plaintiff No. 1 and father of plaintiff No. 2; that the two Sons of Dwarika Nath and their co-sharers settled the suit, land measuring an area of 1.56 acres to Sasti Charan father of defendants 15- 17 by registered patta dated 16.12.48 and Sasti Charan paid rent. Sasti Charan allowed the possession of the suit land and the suit land is wrongly recorded in his name in A. Khatian and after his death his three Sons defendant Nos. 15-17 transferred the suit land to defendant Nos. 10-14 by their registered kabia dated 29.6.76 and the defendants Nos. 10-14 have been possessing the suit land. Defendant Nos. 15-17 never returned the original patta to the plaintiffs. Hence the suit is liable to be dismissed.
